thread:
Maya (PM): ok team — quick sync. We need alignment on the ramp constraints for the next tenant launch. Customer asks for private deploy + HSM by end of month. Can we get capacity, security review, and a runtime plan for quantization tradeoffs? @Ben @Luis @Sophie @Amir

Ben (Eng): timeline check — current sprint has runtime refactors + canary work; adding HSM gating will likely shift delivery ~2 sprints unless we scope down. do we have to ship HSM day 1?

Luis (Runtime): runtime side: we support 8k seq and KV cache. HSM requires a secure connector and perf validation. estimate for connector + tests: ~10 business days with a dedicated eng pair.

Sophie (Infra): capacity note — Dedicated reserved slots exist but private onprem/stg needs a separate cluster. For a staging window we can do a 48h prewarm in the week of Apr 12, but need exact vm/gpu and network constraints to provision.

Amir (Security): security review queue: we can fast-track if we get an early design doc + threat model by EOD Friday. HSM certs mean KMS integration + key lifecycle docs; compliance will need to review export controls.

Tina (ProdOps): proposing launch criteria: 1) perf within SLO (p99 < 300ms for small requests), 2) no regressions on eval set, 3) security signoff + compliance ok, 4) capacity pinned + autoscale validated in staging.

Maya (PM): +1 Tina. We need to pick tradeoffs: defer quantization to post-launch vs delay HSM. Customer insists on HSM but might accept phased approach.

Ben (Eng): my +1 to phased approach: ship HSM later is higher risk to launch timeline. quantization can introduce quality regressions; better to keep initial model unquantized behind HSM if needed.

Luis (Runtime): agree. Unquantized on HSM increases cost but reduces model-change risk. We can mitigate cost with KV prefix caching and smart batching; that'll cut token cost for common flows.

Sophie (Infra): I'll trigger cluster reservations for Apr12 prewarm (gpu-a500x2) once Maya confirms instance types and IP allowlist for customer. Also need a service account for the HSM connector.

Maya (PM): Confirming — I'll draft and share the design doc today with proposed deadlines. Action items: Maya write doc, Ben pair with Luis for HSM connector plan, Sophie reserve stg cluster + IP rules, Amir kick off security review. I'll add deadlines in the doc.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: PROD-7853 tenant-private-prewarm — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-7853

Ben (Eng): quick prewarm config snippet to iterate off of:
```
prewarm:
  duration: 48h
  target_qps: 50
  model_variant: unquantized-v1
```

Amir (Security): noted. @Maya please add compliance contact (Lena) to the design doc and cc. Also include a short checklist: key-rotation plan, audit-log retention, threat-model summary.

Tina (ProdOps): + rollout plan suggestion: canary (2%) -> stage (20%) -> full, with automatic fallback to hosted model if error-rate > 2% or latency regressions.

Maya (PM): thanks all. I'll share the doc in #product and ping infra/security separately. reconvene Thu 11:00 if not blocked. :thumbsup:
